services.name: skaegis
services.purpose: Continuous CVE detection: the Detect step of the suite (Defend sksec, Detect skaegis, Remediate skpatch)

services.name: skai
services.purpose: SKAI is the estate's answer engine: fast chat with any model behind an OpenAI-compatible gateway

services.name: skbackup
services.purpose: Snapshots, per-app copies, dump hooks, restic offsite, restore tests, alerts on the storage host

services.name: skbom
services.purpose: OWASP Dependency-Track (SBOM store + CVE matching), the image-patching half of the skpatch program

services.name: skcorpus
services.purpose: Small, read-only OpenAPI tool server (FastAPI) that lets the skai answer engine search our own knowledge corpora

services.name: skembed
services.purpose: SKEmbed serves one text embedding model on CPU as a swarm service with an OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/embeddings`. It exists so that query embeddings for retrieval (skcorpus) and for uploaded documents (skai) do not need a GPU, and so that the model that built a vector collection is the same one that embeds the queries against it

services.name: skfetch
services.purpose: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr and qBittorrent behind a VPN
services.upstream: qmcgaw/gluetun, lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent, lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr, lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr and more

services.name: skflow
services.purpose: Windmill workflow engine shared by tenant stacks (flows, schedules, webhooks, approvals)

services.name: skgym
services.purpose: openGym gym and body-weight tracker (passkeys, PWA)

services.name: skhealth
services.purpose: Lightweight infrastructure health checks with alerts

services.name: skmon
services.purpose: Observability stack (metrics, logs, alerts, optional profiles)
services.upstream: VictoriaMetrics `v1.155.0`, Grafana Alloy `v1.21.3`, Loki `3.7.10`, Grafana `13.3.1`, Alertmanager `v0.35.0` (all digest-pinned, `pins.yml`)

services.name: sknet
services.purpose: Network flow visibility: Akvorado flow collector and console (Kafka + ClickHouse), optional live view

services.name: skpatch-hosts
services.purpose: Linux update/patch dashboard (SSH, holds a key per estate); host half of the skpatch program

services.name: skpayment
services.purpose: Multi-app Stripe subscription gateway (FastAPI on uvicorn)

services.name: skpods
services.purpose: Solid pod hosting (WebID + storage per user); engine `nextcloud`: a slim standalone Nextcloud with only the Solid app
services.upstream: instance-built engine image (official Nextcloud + Solid app, digest-pinned), Postgres `17.7`, Redis `8.10.3`

services.name: skrac
services.purpose: MeshCentral on the swarm: remote access and device management

services.name: skwrit
services.purpose: Matter engine worker (drafting with gates, release, publishing to Nextcloud)

v2_descriptors.name: capauth
v2_descriptors.purpose: Sovereign machine-to-machine auth: PGP-based CapAuth for agent identity and secret access without OAuth.
v2_descriptors.provider: CapAuth (sovereign PGP-based; skcapstone MCP integration)

v2_descriptors.name: skca
v2_descriptors.purpose: Internal PKI / mTLS: step-ca for ACME internal cert issuance, X.509 mTLS service identity, and SSH CA.
v2_descriptors.provider: step-ca (ACME for internal endpoints, X.509 mTLS, SSH certificate authority)

v2_descriptors.name: sksec
v2_descriptors.purpose: Threat defense: CrowdSec (reputation + bouncer) + Falco (runtime/eBPF) + Wazuh (HIDS/FIM/SIEM) + Suricata (NIDS).
v2_descriptors.provider: CrowdSec (reputation/bouncer) + Falco (runtime eBPF) + Wazuh (HIDS/FIM/SIEM) + Suricata (NIDS)

v2_descriptors.name: sksso
v2_descriptors.purpose: Identity / SSO: Authentik for human SSO (OIDC/SAML/LDAP); Zitadel path for agent/M2M service auth.
v2_descriptors.provider: Authentik (human SSO, OIDC/SAML/LDAP); Zitadel as M2M/agent service-auth upgrade path

v2_descriptors.name: skvault
v2_descriptors.purpose: Secrets management: the SKSecretBackend port; vault-file / HashiCorp Vault / CapAuth adapters, all sharing the same interface.
v2_descriptors.provider: SKSecretBackend interface (secrets/interface.py): OpenBao (HA Raft, default) / vault-file (AES-256) / SOPS+age / CapAuth (PGP); HashiCorp Vault = compatible alt

v2_descriptors.name: skwaf
v2_descriptors.purpose: Web application firewall: Coraza + OWASP CRS v4 as Traefik WASM plugin (zero new processes, config change only).
v2_descriptors.provider: Coraza WAF + OWASP CRS v4 (Traefik WASM plugin; BunkerWeb as GUI alternative)

v2_descriptors.name: skbus
v2_descriptors.purpose: Machine A2A event bus: NATS JetStream for sovereign agent-to-agent messaging (subjects: skos.agent.*.events).
v2_descriptors.provider: NATS JetStream (10 MB binary, sub-millisecond latency, built-in persistence)

v2_descriptors.name: skchat
v2_descriptors.purpose: Human/agent chat + federation: Tuwunel (Apache-2.0 Rust Matrix homeserver, single binary, low-RAM). Keeps the Matrix protocol; swaps the homeserver off Synapse.
v2_descriptors.provider: Tuwunel (Apache-2.0, Rust single-binary Matrix homeserver; conduwuit successor)

v2_descriptors.name: skcomms
v2_descriptors.purpose: Multi-channel outbound transport (17 paths): subscribes to skbus and routes messages to Telegram, email, SMS, etc.
v2_descriptors.provider: skcomms (sovereign, custom): subscribes to NATS JetStream skbus

v2_descriptors.name: skvoice
v2_descriptors.purpose: Voice/video RTC: LiveKit SFU with Agents framework wiring STT+TTS+LLM as room participants.
v2_descriptors.provider: LiveKit (SFU + Agents framework: STT=Whisper, TTS=Chatterbox, LLM=Ollama)

v2_descriptors.name: skbackup
v2_descriptors.purpose: Backup: Restic to Garage S3 backend (replaces Duplicati which has corruption-bug history).
v2_descriptors.provider: Restic (→ Garage S3); Kopia (GUI alt) / Borg (fast local restore) as alternatives

v2_descriptors.name: skblock
v2_descriptors.purpose: HA replicated block storage (RWO) for databases / StatefulSets.
v2_descriptors.provider: Longhorn (Apache-2.0, K8s-native synchronous replication + S3 backup)

v2_descriptors.name: skcache
v2_descriptors.purpose: Cache / KV store: Valkey (BSD-3 Redis drop-in; Redis 8 went AGPLv3 May 2025: swap is 1 config change).
v2_descriptors.provider: Valkey (BSD-3, drop-in Redis replacement); DragonflyDB as scale alternative

v2_descriptors.name: skdata
v2_descriptors.purpose: Relational + vector + graph + search: Postgres 17 with pgvector, pg_search (BM25), and Apache AGE (graph).
v2_descriptors.provider: PostgreSQL 17 (skmem-pg:pg17-bm25-age image: pgvector + ParadeDB pg_search + Apache AGE: one engine)

v2_descriptors.name: skfile
v2_descriptors.purpose: HA shared POSIX file storage (RWX): JuiceFS over the object layer.
v2_descriptors.provider: JuiceFS CE (Apache-2.0; data=skobject S3, metadata=PostgreSQL/skdata)

v2_descriptors.name: skfiles
v2_descriptors.purpose: File sync and collaboration: Nextcloud for web/team collaboration + Syncthing for sovereign p2p device sync.
v2_descriptors.provider: Nextcloud (collaboration/WebDAV) + Syncthing (p2p sync)

v2_descriptors.name: skflow
v2_descriptors.purpose: Automation / workflow: visual and code-first automation with human-in-the-loop support for agent pipelines.
v2_descriptors.provider: Windmill (AGPLv3, OSI-open, code-first; visual + scripts)

v2_descriptors.name: skmodel
v2_descriptors.purpose: LLM / inference serving: stable seam for model-serving; Ollama for simplicity, vLLM for throughput at scale.
v2_descriptors.provider: Ollama (simple, wide model support); vLLM (high-throughput production serving)

v2_descriptors.name: skmon
v2_descriptors.purpose: Observability (metrics + logs + traces): Prometheus + Grafana + Loki + Tempo + Grafana Alloy (OTel collector).
v2_descriptors.provider: Prometheus (metrics) + Grafana (dashboards) + Loki (logs; the strategic log store, Chef 2026-11-11) + Tempo (traces) + Grafana Alloy (OTel)

v2_descriptors.name: skobject
v2_descriptors.purpose: Object / S3 storage: Garage (replaces archived MinIO Apr 2026; single binary, AGPLv3, S3-compatible).
v2_descriptors.provider: Garage (AGPLv3, single binary, S3-compatible); SeaweedFS for Object-Lock / large scale

v2_descriptors.name: skpulse
v2_descriptors.purpose: Uptime / status monitoring: Uptime-Kuma with Blackbox Exporter for internal endpoint probing.
v2_descriptors.provider: Gatus (config-as-code uptime, feeds skops ITIL) + Prometheus Blackbox Exporter (internal probing)

v2_descriptors.name: skcicd
v2_descriptors.purpose: CI/CD: Forgejo Actions (CI) + Ansible (Swarm/node CD) + ArgoCD (Kubernetes GitOps).
v2_descriptors.provider: Forgejo Actions (CI) + Ansible (node/Swarm CD) + ArgoCD (K8s GitOps)

v2_descriptors.name: skdns
v2_descriptors.purpose: Sovereign DNS: internal authoritative DNS + resolver/filter with split-horizon and DNS-01 ACME support.
v2_descriptors.provider: Technitium (self-host: authoritative + recursive + filtering + DoH/DoT/DoQ, one binary)

v2_descriptors.name: skdweb
v2_descriptors.purpose: Decentralized availability + sovereign naming: IPFS content pinning and HNS/ENS seizure-proof names.
v2_descriptors.provider: IPFS + IPFS-Cluster (content availability) + Handshake HNS / ENS (sovereign naming)

v2_descriptors.name: skfence
v2_descriptors.purpose: Traefik v3 reverse proxy with ACME TLS, rate limiting, and socket proxy.
v2_descriptors.provider: Traefik v3 + Coraza WAF (Traefik WASM plugin; Keepalived for Swarm HA / kube-vip for K8s)

v2_descriptors.name: skinfra
v2_descriptors.purpose: Infrastructure provisioning: OpenTofu modules for Hetzner, Proxmox, and Cloudflare targets.
v2_descriptors.provider: OpenTofu (Terraform-compatible, BSL-free)

v2_descriptors.name: skmesh
v2_descriptors.purpose: Overlay mesh / tunnel: sovereign WireGuard-based networking across nodes.
v2_descriptors.provider: Netbird (self-hosted, sovereign target); Tailscale for ease + bootstrap; Pangolin as sovereign cloudflared replacement

v2_descriptors.name: skturn
v2_descriptors.purpose: WebRTC TURN/STUN media relay (coturn). Host-published edge service; the media plane that cannot traverse Traefik/cloudflared.
v2_descriptors.provider: coturn 4.6 (host-published edge node; DNS grey-cloud / DNS-only)
